customManagers.description: Builder image versions pinned as ARGs below a marker comment. A marker with tag= or branch= pins a commit, which moves with that tag or branch.
CI tools downloaded by a release URL below a marker comment; the version appears twice in the URL and both move.

packageRules.description: Crates the released crates compile in ship to every product built on samplez, so they land as fix(deps) and cut a release. Grouped because the exact pins of one crate across the workspace must move together. 14 days because lint fails a crates.io release younger than that.
libm and xxhash-rust decide the samples and the page hashes, so a bump is a COMPUTE_VERSION or PROTOCOL question and gets a PR of its own that the goldens judge.
Crates only tests use ship nothing, so they cut no release.
The builder image is the build and test environment, not part of a release.
The Debian base is tagged <suite>-<date>, which only a regex orders.
gungraun-runner in the builder has to be the version of the gungraun crate the benches link, so both move in one PR.
A nightly appears every day; the RealtimeSanitizer gate needs one at a time, so it is offered once a month.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: vcpkg is pinned to a master commit; once a month keeps it near the registry without a PR per commit.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Renovate cannot compute the rustup-init checksum, so the PR fails the builder build until RUSTUP_SHA256 is replaced by hand.
prBodyNotes: Replace `RUSTUP_SHA256` with the value from `https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/archive/{{{newValue}}}/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init.sha256`; the builder build fails until then.

packageRules.description: Renovate cannot compute the cargo-deny tarball checksum, so lint fails until it is replaced by hand. A CI tool cuts no release.
prBodyNotes: Replace the sha256 next to `DENY` with the release's `cargo-deny-{{{newValue}}}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz.sha256` asset; lint fails until then.

packageRules.description: libmxl is the Rust bindings in the released crates and the C library in the builder, which must be the same commit, so they move in one PR. Not delayed, so an upstream release that breaks samplez surfaces at once as a CI-red PR.
prBodyNotes: README.md, AGENTS.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md name the libmxl version samplez needs at run time; move them with it.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions and runner bumps into one PR; CI only, so no release.
